thesis: COLM is a post-earnings re-rated name (Sep-26 net income +63% YoY, positive FCF, low dilution risk) holding near its 52-week high with rs_63 +0.37 in XLY, one of the few leading sectors in a risk-off tape. The pullback setup has R/R of about 2.0 at mid-zone 73.65 (stop 70.0, target 81.0), but at the last close of 75.77 R/R is only about 0.9 with RSI 71 and a 7% extension above SMA20. Under the standing rule to downgrade to Hold when R/R at the last price is below 1.5, this stays Hold now; the pre-close review should reconsider Overweight if price trades into 72.8-74.5 while holding above SMA20 (~70.7).
invalidation: A daily close below 70.0 (under the 70.47 swing low and the breakout base) voids the setup.
